dedupe_keys.name: 指定避難所 evacuation shelters and public facilities series on bodik odcs

description: 指定避難所 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] (series on BODIK ODCS) is a series of datasets listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by BODIK (Open Data Catalogue Service of Japanese local governments). 災害対策基本法（平成25年6月改正）で規定された指定避難所 （災害の危険があり避難した住民等を一定の期間滞在させる施設）の一覧表です。 市町が指定したものを順次掲載します。. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 7 publishers. Its tags are 災害, 避難所, 避難所-位置情報, 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Data License 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
